fact: The World Bank's joint review mission of 18-29 November 2024 records that over 6,000 tablets under Wi De Ya / One Tablet per School had been procured and were to be delivered to the TSC in February 2025, then distributed to all public primary schools (6,061, by 30 April 2025) for the teacher attendance monitoring system, continuous professional development and lesson observations; learner attendance or learner records are not named among the uses.
title: Sierra Leone: Free Education Project (P167897) Joint Implementation Review Mission (JIRM) November 18-29, 2024: Aide Memoire
